sam: FYI we're running a pen-test dry run next Wednesday (readroom-style). Need a tight playbook: RBAC snapshot + diffs, KMS readroom grants (no key material export), and an audit export plan that ties events to assessor sessions. Who can pick what?
laura: I got RBAC snapshot + diffs. Will map roles -> services, list any wildcard bindings. Will include deny-tests. ETA Tue EOD.
andre: I'll take KMS. Confirming approach: create KMS Grant for Decrypt + ephemeral IAM role. No key export, no HSM key material out. Any objections?
tia: Sounds good. For logs: full fidelity for KMS/auth events. For app-level logs, propose 1-in-25 sampling and keep a short hot window (90d) and cold archive (365d) for legal. We'll tag assessor sessions so we can pull a contiguous view.
mike: I can cover oncall for the window. Quick rollback play ready if anything fails.
laura: After assessor access closes we must rotate the assessor role and revoke active grants. I'll add a post-readroom rotate step and a smoke-run of deny-tests. `./tools/rbac-smoke --role assessor --env staging`
dev-ops-bot: kms-readroom job queued: https://ci.internal/jobs/8432 
--- config snippet ---
proxy:
  name: kms-readroom-proxy
  env: staging
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  session_tag: assessor_session
----------------------
andre: TTL 1 hour OK? Need cloudtrail/session-tag to be searchable. Also will produce a short runbook for grant revoke: `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id GRANT_ID` and role rotation steps.
tia: 1h TTL is fine. CloudTrail records will include the session tag; example query: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=assessor_session`
sam: I'll create the JIRA board and wire the remediation tracker so each vuln has: vuln-id, owner, PR link, target deploy window, and retest slot. Please attach RBAC diff + sample log export to the ticket.
laura: Also adding an evidence manifest template (S3 presigned bundle) for the assessors to drop logs into. We'll sign manifests with SLSA metadata.
mike: Confirming I'll run quick smoke checks during the readroom (auth flow + deny-tests). If anything high-sev appears, we'll pause and revoke grants.
andre: I'll document the revoke flow and add a small Lambda to snapshot active grants at start and ensure clean revocation at end.
sam: Action recap: laura = RBAC snapshot + evidence manifest + rotate step; andre = KMS grants, proxy job, revoke runbook; tia = audit sampling policy + cloudtrail queries; mike = oncall + smoke checks; sam = JIRA board + vuln->PR mapping + retest slots. Follow up Monday 09:30 to validate artifacts. :thumbsup:
